lead: A `# Known gaps` item can be prose the code has already closed.
body: `crates/nvs-cli/src/openapi.rs` gap 5 said an enum capture reaches the document as *any* while `RouteParam::admits` had been handing `schema` the case spellings under a guard test. Nothing recompiles a gap's sentence when the code under it moves, so the item is the one part of a module doc that is not evidence. Read the path an item names and the test beside it before deciding its owner, and strike the item where the code is ahead of it.
